sources.EDDI: NOAA PSL EDDI CONUS archive (EDDI_ETrs_03mn, EDDI_ETrs_06wk); empty outside CONUS

units.EDDI_ETrs_03m: EDDI sigma (monthly mean of daily 3-month ETrs EDDI)
units.EDDI_ETrs_06wk: EDDI sigma (monthly mean of daily 6-week ETrs EDDI)

notes: q850/q250 derived from temperature and relative humidity at the pressure level
tmax is the monthly mean of daily maximum 2-m temperature
EDDI values are blank for locations outside the CONUS EDDI grid
